column5: CodecVer, IsNewFormat, and IsRowKey are source-shaped; dependency-closed row header/ID/offset framing is exposed without runtime keyspace policy, typed Datum conversion, checksum calculation, or encoder/decoder ownership.

The six-byte header, large/small metadata widths, sorted ID partitions, monotonic end offsets, opaque data boundary, checksum trailer framing, binary-search column lookup, and default-null decision are ported; typed row encoding/decoding, schema defaults, handles, and checksum calculation remain open.
